Loading Eucalypt occurrences
```{r}
library(sp)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

euc_names <- read.csv("data/name_matched_list.csv", header=T)

euc_coords <- read.csv("data/euc_coords.csv", header=T) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  filter(scientificName %in% euc_names$current_name)

coords <- cbind(euc_coords$decimalLongitude, euc_coords$decimalLatitude)

euc_sp <- SpatialPoints(coords, proj4string=CRS("+init=epsg:4326"))

```


Loading precipitation rasters from worldclim
```{r}
library(raster)

MAP <- raster("data/MAP.tif")
MAT <- raster("data/MAT.tif")
seasonality <- raster("data/seasonality.tif")
wetq <- raster("data/wet_quarter.tif")
dryq <- raster("data/dry_quarter.tif")
```


Extracting climate data from points
```{r}
euc_coords$MAP <- raster::extract(MAP, euc_sp)
euc_coords$MAT <- raster::extract(MAT, euc_sp)
euc_coords$seasonality <- raster::extract(seasonality, euc_sp)
euc_coords$wetq <- raster::extract(wetq, euc_sp)
euc_coords$dryq <- raster::extract(dryq, euc_sp)

euc_climate_data <- euc_coords %>% 
  group_by(scientificName) %>% 
  summarise(mean_MAP=mean(MAP, na.rm=T), 
            min_MAP=min(MAP, na.rm=T),
            MAT=mean(MAT, na.rm=T),
            seasonality=mean(seasonality, na.rm=T),
            wetq=mean(wetq, na.rm=T),
            dryq=mean(dryq, na.rm=T))
```

Creating master spreadsheet
```{r}
image_data <- read.csv("data/xylem_areas2.csv", header=T) 

euc_database <- image_data %>% 
  separate(Image, c("family", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") %>% 
  separate(other, c("species", "state", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(species, state, other, Name, Area.µm.2)) %>% 
  mutate(radius = sqrt(Area.µm.2/pi)) %>% 
  left_join(euc_names, by = "species") %>% 
  left_join(euc_climate_data, by = c("current_name" = "scientificName"))

```


Calculating Hydraulically weighted diameter Dh
```{r}
xylem_Dh <- euc_database %>% 
  filter(Name=="vessel") %>% 
  mutate(r5 = radius^5,
         r4 = radius^4) %>% 
  group_by(current_name, other) %>% 
  summarise(Dh = sum(r5)/ sum(r4)) %>% 
  group_by(current_name) %>% 
  summarise(mean_Dh = mean(Dh, na.rm=T)) %>% 
  left_join(euc_climate_data, by = c("current_name" = "scientificName")) %>% 
  mutate(highly_seasonal = seasonality > 60) %>% 
  drop_na()

```

```{r}
Dh_regression = list()

climate_vars = colnames(xylem_Dh[,3:8])

for (var in climate_vars) {
  formula <- paste("mean_Dh ~", var)
  Dh_regression[[var]] <- lm(formula, data = xylem_Dh)
}
```


```{r}
Dh_plots = list()

for (var in climate_vars) {
  Dh_plots[[var]] <- xylem_Dh %>% 
    ggplot(aes_string(x = var, y = "mean_Dh")) + geom_point()
}

for (plot in Dh_plots) {
  plot(plot)
}
```


Calculating lumen fractions
```{r}
xylem_lumen <- euc_database %>% 
  group_by(current_name, other, Name) %>% 
  summarise(total_area = sum(Area.µm.2)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Name, values_from = total_area) %>% 
  mutate(lumen_frac = (part+vessel)/PathAnnotationObject) %>% 
  group_by(current_name) %>% 
  summarise(mean_lumen_frac = mean(lumen_frac, na.rm=T)) %>% 
  left_join(euc_climate_data, by = c("current_name" = "scientificName")) %>% 
  mutate(highly_seasonal = seasonality > 60) %>% 
  drop_na()

```


```{r}
lumen_regression = list()

for (var in climate_vars) {
  formula <- paste("mean_lumen_frac ~", var)
  lumen_regression[[var]] <- lm(formula, data = xylem_lumen)
}
```


```{r}
lumen_plots = list()

for (var in climate_vars) {
  lumen_plots[[var]] <- xylem_lumen %>% 
    ggplot(aes_string(x = var, y = "mean_lumen_frac")) + geom_point()
}

for (plot in lumen_plots) {
  plot(plot)
}
```


Comparing Dh to lumen fraction
```{r}
species_summary <- xylem_Dh %>% 
  left_join(xylem_lumen[,1:2], by = "current_name") 

Dh_lumen_plot <- species_summary %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_lumen_frac, y = mean_Dh)) + 
  geom_point()

plot(Dh_lumen_plot)

Dh_lumen_lm <- lm(mean_Dh~mean_lumen_frac, data = species_summary)
summary(Dh_lumen_lm)
```

PCA
```{r}
library(vegan)

species_standardised <- species_summary %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c("current_name", "highly_seasonal")) %>% 
  scale()

xylem_PCA <- princomp(species_standardised, cor = FALSE)
screeplot(xylem_PCA, type = "lines")
summary(xylem_PCA)
loadings(xylem_PCA)
biplot(xylem_PCA)
```
